mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing China turning its back and looking toward Taiwan while salivating, and says the Lord showed him that in the days ahead China will take Taiwan, beginning to give a year.
mentions.quote: in the days ahead, China will take Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: China takes Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Elsewhere he puts the fall in the tribulation on a ten year window, which is a much longer frame than days ahead.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a Chinese official saying in English that there is but one China and Taiwan is an inalienable part of it, presenting it as an announcement that they are going to take Taiwan.
mentions.quote: There's but one China in the world and Taiwan is an inalienable
mentions.falsify_match: China acts on the statement.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. This is the standing Chinese position restated, not a new declaration.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them attack Taiwan and then hit the islands of Hawaii with a surprise Pearl Harbor style attack, with fire and people running.
mentions.quote: they hit the islands of Hawaii with a surprise Pearl Harbor attack
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese attack on Hawaii following a move on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He notes China saying Iran has a right to use nuclear energy and that China is really backing them, and repeats that in the days ahead he saw them taking Taiwan.
mentions.quote: China's really backing them
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese material support for Iran and a move on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says the uranium is buried deep in the earth and that they were splitting it up between places in case some was found, and that they had one atomic device that had not been tested.
mentions.quote: they had one one bomb that was an atom that hadn't b
mentions.falsify_match: Dispersed Iranian uranium and a single untested device are confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither is found.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a Jason Bourne type scene in which Russia and America eliminate the man's life in the days ahead, followed by a proxy government that is pro-Ukraine and pro-Russia.
mentions.quote: Russia and America will eliminate his life. I saw it
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky is killed and a partitioned proxy government follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains in office. Naming both Russia and America as the actors is a specific and unusual attribution.

mentions.claim_text: He says it would kill over three hundred and fifty million people in the days ahead, that the Lord showed him it would be from a lab, and that he said this on a named broadcast over a year earlier right after the president's ear was struck.
mentions.quote: it would kill over 350 million people in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic on that scale traced to a laboratory.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The pre-commitment date is checkable against the named broadcast.

mentions.claim_text: He says a man travelled by cruise ship to Switzerland and it is supposedly spreading, that it is carried by mice and rats and is in Switzerland, and that the Lord said it would start in Europe.
mentions.quote: It's by a mice. It's by rats. It's in Switzerland
mentions.falsify_match: A rodent borne outbreak establishes itself in Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a death ratio skyrocketing higher than COVID, that it started in Europe which he found interesting, and an announcement that they were going into lockdowns again.
mentions.quote: The death ratio was skyrocketing even more higher than COVID
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic with a higher fatality rate than COVID and new lockdowns.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a call for no international flights in or out and an extended lockdown of some twenty days to stop the spread because there were cases in America.
mentions.quote: He was calling for no flights international coming in or going out
mentions.falsify_match: An international flight ban and a multi week American lockdown.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them it would spread in Europe first, that it causes the euro to crash, that it was the plan to bring in digital currencies and destroy the euro, and that it would eventually affect the American economy.
mentions.quote: it causes the euro to crash
mentions.falsify_match: A euro collapse used to introduce digital currency.
mentions.falsify_miss: The euro holds.

mentions.claim_text: He asks his son to replay the end of the original video from the time of the president's ear, saying he saw a black thin thing in it.
mentions.quote: I said I saw a black thin thing
mentions.falsify_match: The recording contains the detail he claims.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. This one is checkable directly from his own archive.

mentions.claim_text: He asks listeners to picture everyone in the country dead, notes there are only three hundred and forty eight million people coast to coast, and repeats the figure.
mentions.quote: There's only 348 million people that live from coast to coast
mentions.falsify_match: A death toll comparable to the American population.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He uses the population figure to convey the scale, which is a real check on his own number.

mentions.claim_text: He says people question the number but the Lord gives him specific numbers, that he saw them all in freezers and a big ship parked outside New York.
mentions.quote: I saw them all in freezers. And I saw a big cross ship parked outside
mentions.falsify_match: Mortuary overflow and a hospital ship at New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He describes defibrillator paddles hitting the nation of America with shockwaves and pulses going over the land.
mentions.quote: I saw those hitting the nation of America. And I saw shockwaves
mentions.falsify_match: A series of national shocks producing a religious response.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says people got freaked out when it was breaking out but were not taking it seriously in China, and that this was to derail the revival that is about to take place.
mentions.quote: this was to derail the revival that's about to take
mentions.falsify_match: An outbreak that disrupts a religious movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. The framing means an outbreak with no revival still fits.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is holding the church accountable for how they pray for this man, mentions praying for the vice president and the secretary of state, and says he saw a two term president coming.
mentions.quote: I saw a two-term president coming
mentions.falsify_match: A successor serves two terms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. The accountability clause means a failure is attributable to the church.

mentions.claim_text: He takes authority over the virus and declares that it dies on that boat immediately and will not spread any further over Europe, applying the blood over Europe.
mentions.quote: it dies on that boat right now, and it will not spread anymore
mentions.falsify_match: The outbreak stops at that point.
mentions.falsify_miss: It spreads. He also claims elsewhere that it will spread through Europe, so both directions are covered.

mentions.claim_text: He instructs putting anointing oil around the house, arguing that if the death angel passed by the children of Israel it will pass by them, and that they are hidden in the cleft of the rock.
mentions.quote: We put anointing oil all around our house
mentions.falsify_match: Those who follow the instruction are visibly spared.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. The condition puts any harm on the hearer.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a massive mothership like the one in a named film hovering over the Vatican, and a demonic thing going over the Mayan temples in the Mexico and South America area.
mentions.quote: A massive mothership thing will be over the Vatican
mentions.falsify_match: A widely witnessed aerial object over those sites.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears.

mentions.claim_text: He says it moves at the speed of sound and will frighten everyone, with lightning and lightning bolts coming off it, and that it looked like something out of a science fiction film.
mentions.quote: It's going to freak everybody out
mentions.falsify_match: An unexplained aerial event causing worldwide alarm.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed him five different reptilian races while he was praying, one in Asia, one in North America, one in Europe and one in Africa, and that it went on.
mentions.quote: I saw five different reptilian races
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim is about hidden lineages.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warned about giants upon the land and that the flood came because they were trying to destroy the pure human bloodline, with angels sleeping with women.
mentions.quote: they were trying to destroy the bloodline of pure human
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; an account of prehistory.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is very cautious about what he lets in and watchful because he does not know who people are, and is not saying they are bad.
mentions.quote: I'm very cautious about what I let in
mentions.falsify_match: He continues to distinguish his own material from what he is sent.
mentions.falsify_miss: He absorbs material from unverified sources.

mentions.claim_text: He says each lineage looked different from the others, that the one in Saudi Arabia looked different from the one in England, and that the one around Mexico and South America looked like a bird lizard.
mentions.quote: Look like a bird lizard thing
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw an asteroid and can say where it is in the sky, that the Lord called it Apophis and wormwood and said it is headed for Earth, and that the calculations say the odds are in their favour and it will miss.
mentions.quote: This is Apophis, wormwood, and it's headed for Earth
mentions.falsify_match: Apophis strikes Earth.
mentions.falsify_miss: It misses, which is the calculated trajectory for the 2029 pass and which he acknowledges in the same passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says a sitting and powerful member of Congress called into a meeting held only for pastors in Missouri and asked on speakerphone whether the pastors were listening to him, and that he is getting chills because it happened.
mentions.quote: Are the pastors listening to me?
mentions.falsify_match: The meeting and the call are corroborated.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. He names neither the member nor the meeting.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something being spiced with genetic AI technology, great deception, and quantum computing spinning out of control with a demon behind the computer system helping them.
mentions.quote: I saw a demon behind this computer system helping them
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the mechanism is a demon.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a facility in America, one in Europe and one in China trying to split atoms, and that they were taking old manuscripts and letting AI scan and translate old demonic languages.
mentions.quote: they were taking old manuscripts and allowing AI to scan them
mentions.falsify_match: AI translation of ancient texts at a particle physics facility.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them he saw two thousand dollar stimulus cheques coming, that the maximum he saw was two thousand five hundred and it was being discussed behind closed doors, and jokes that the president must watch the channel.
mentions.quote: 2,500 is what I saw a maximum of
mentions.falsify_match: Stimulus cheques of that size are issued.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is in the news and is what they prayed over, that he saw it in the shot and heard it, and that the president then asked when he had promised two thousand, noting the number matches but he saw twenty five hundred.
mentions.quote: It's even the number, but I saw 2,5
mentions.falsify_match: Cheques at either figure are issued.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are. He notes the two thousand matches but that his own number was different.

mentions.claim_text: He names JP Morgan, BlackRock at a distance, Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America at a meeting, wanting to make sure they got their cut off interest rates and that it did not cross over.
mentions.quote: they wanted to make sure that they got their cut off of interest rates
mentions.falsify_match: Bank negotiations over the crypto bill are documented.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are. The same set of banks is named across several separate claims in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He asks how they will handle the deception when it manifests, says it is not just about America but Europe and all the other nations, mentions the beasts of Africa, and asks whether they will release all of it.
mentions.quote: Will they release all of it
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated disclosure event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He puts it as a question rather than a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees other faces and names a minister he sees, repeating grow several times, placing him in Missouri and saying he will go back to his roots.
mentions.quote: You're going to go back to your roots
mentions.falsify_match: That minister's ministry changes direction as described.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He names Florida, Tennessee, Mississippi, Alabama, Missouri, Colorado and Texas and says they are all over, that these are strategic voices and the Lord is going to use them.
mentions.quote: They're strategic voices
mentions.falsify_match: Named ministers in those states become prominent in a movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He names another broadcaster, says he does not know where he is now but saw his face a moment ago, and that these are strategic people on the internet for when the deception comes.
mentions.quote: these are strategic people on the internet
mentions.falsify_match: Those named take a leading role during a disclosure event.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Act is coming to pass and a major harvest is coming at last, calls it in with no more delay, and says Jesus is coming soon.
mentions.quote: A major harvest is coming at last. No more delay
mentions.falsify_match: The act passes and a movement follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He blesses the citizens of Israel and the Jewish people, and recalls seeing the Israeli prime minister being removed because of decisions and because he stood against the two-state solution.
mentions.quote: Benjamin being removed because of decisions
mentions.falsify_match: Netanyahu is removed over the two-state question.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees cures and medical breakthroughs coming out of Israel with AI advancements, and agricultural acceleration involving the soil for crops in drought.
mentions.quote: I see cures coming from Israel. I see medical breakthrough
mentions.falsify_match: Israeli medical or agricultural breakthroughs at that scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerge. Israeli agritech is an established export sector, which lowers what the claim adds.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the golf course on Gaza again and says the named developers will start to develop Gaza with hotels and buildings pretty quickly, calling the course beautiful.
mentions.quote: I see the Trump golf course again on the Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: Gaza redevelopment begins with a named golf course.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does.

mentions.claim_text: He says this will happen a lot in South America, sees Latino women down by Panama and Guatemala, sees a lake and says it is what is in the lake, and that they will try to mess with people's minds as a distraction.
mentions.quote: I see a lake. It's what's in the lake
mentions.falsify_match: Something found in a Central American lake becomes a major story.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does; he does not say what is in it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they tap into demonic portals through the particle facility, that he sees one in America and one in Asia, and remarks that people thought he made it up.
mentions.quote: As they tap into some kind of demonic portals through CERN
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the mechanism is a portal.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says what would be called science fiction is real, that they are playing with dark things they should not be playing with, that they are playing with fire, and begins on the AI.
mentions.quote: It's not sci-fi. It's real
mentions.falsify_match: An AI or physics programme produces a catastrophic result.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does.

mentions.claim_text: He works out the time difference with California and Ireland with his co-host, noting it is not late there and it has only just got dark.
mentions.quote: It's not late there. It just got dark
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a production aside.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has an urgency to tell them they must wake up, that he sees the headlines in the papers and what the Lord is showing him about this and other nations, a shaking to awaken, and that the Lord said Cuba is next.
mentions.quote: The Lord said Cuba is next
mentions.falsify_match: American action on Cuba follows the Iran matter.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that David will slay his tens of thousands and Saul his thousands, says there are things the secretary of state will be seen to do in the days ahead, and that a shaking is coming to Cuba and the Latino community.
mentions.quote: There's things that you will see Marco Rubio do in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio takes a leading role on Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president describing a talented architect with a Hispanic flair who came from Cuba, which he says they will be taking over almost immediately, adding that Cuba has problems.
mentions.quote: a place called Cuba, which we will be taking over almost immediately
mentions.falsify_match: An American takeover of Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The remark is made in an aside about an architect.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said it is coming and the shaking of Cuba is coming, that he believes it with all his heart, that the Lord said he will bring great revival to Cuba, and that the president is joking about it but he believes it.
mentions.quote: I'm going to bring great revival to Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised Cuban revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He notes the president is joking, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the man trying to eat it and two paths, one where he boards a plane with many hundred dollar bills for another nation and one where he is taken out in a building, with a new government coming in.
mentions.quote: I saw him getting on a plane with lots of $100 bills
mentions.falsify_match: Either of the two outcomes he names.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Giving two paths means the two together cover most possibilities.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw two black crows looking at a dead dove's body, a turtle wearing glasses, that the cardinal and the turtle were friends, a weasel scheming in France, and a cobra coming.
mentions.quote: I saw two black crows looking at the dead dove's body
mentions.falsify_match: The animals resolve to identifiable European figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not, except where he assigns them afterwards.

mentions.claim_text: He notes reports of trying to pull out of NATO and pulling five thousand troops out of Germany, and says that is what they saw on the Thursday.
mentions.quote: we're pulling out 5,000 troops out of Germany
mentions.falsify_match: An American drawdown in Europe or a NATO withdrawal.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is asking for help in the strait and under the table deals, and that this is why he saw they would try it, noting a report of Europe being rattled.
mentions.quote: Asking for help in the strait. And I saw under the table deals
mentions.falsify_match: Undisclosed negotiations over the strait are revealed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are.

mentions.claim_text: He says the visions the Lord has him praying over are all very similar and very different, in the way the picture is and in how he is shown to pray for the nation, for revival and for a shaking.
mentions.quote: they're all very similar, very different
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a description of his method.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the same colours and says he was warned this was a very dangerous thing, then turns to a report of NATO moving a thousand troops with heavy gear to Russia's doorstep in Poland.
mentions.quote: NATO wave a thousand of troops to heavy gear on Russian doorsteps
mentions.falsify_match: A NATO buildup in Poland followed by a Russian response.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says it did not destroy land, that the Lord said it is not nuclear and is a weapon that has never been used which looked nuclear but was not, that it is by Warsaw, and that they will provoke.
mentions.quote: It is not nuclear. It is a weapon that has never been used
mentions.falsify_match: A novel non-nuclear weapon used near Warsaw.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is.
